text:
Type: gold metal tealight holder
Use: holding a tealight on a table or shelf; living room, dining room
Style: glam, art deco, contemporary
Materials: polished metal with a mirror-like gold finish
Colors: bright warm gold
Shape: flared sculptural cup that opens into curled petal-like flaps, like a calla lily, narrow base and wide mouth, small and eye-catching
Feel: festive, luminous, elegant
Goes with: dark or white tables, marble, velvet, black or green accents; glam, art deco or contemporary dining rooms

product.name: STILLHET
product.description: Use the tealight holder with a lit tealight or alone, as a beautiful object in its own right.
